example_sentences_in_bangla: সংকটের মুহূর্তে সে গভীরজলের মাছের মতো অটল রইল।
তার স্থিরতা দেখে মনে হয় সে গভীরজলের মাছ।
example_sentences_in_english: In the moment of crisis, he remained unflappable like a deep-water fish.
His composure makes him seem like a deep-water fish.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of fish in deep, still waters symbolizing composure in Bengali folklore and everyday language.
